newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey Jan-April trade gap up 1.4 pct to $5.76 bln.
newsitem.headline: Turkey Jan-April trade gap up 1.4 pct to $5.76 bln.

text.p: Turkey's foreign trade deficit in the January to April period rose 1.4 percent year-on-year to $5.76 billion from $5.68 billion, the State Statistics Institute said.
Exports in the four months to April rose 6.3 percent to $7.80 billion, while imports climbed 4.2 percent to $13.56 billion, the statistics office said.
In April, the trade deficit dropped 15.2 percent to $1.48 billion. April exports were up 6.2 percent to $1.94 billion, while imports fell 4.2 percent to $3.42 billion.
